limitations: Four conservative implementation-reviewed entries for a File Search capability test. This is not the required 20–30-entry pilot corpus or a claim of evaluation readiness.

entries.title: Reuse of removable hardware
entries.usageBasis: Original concise paraphrase of factual guidance on a United States government page. No source images, branding, or lengthy extracts are ingested.
entries.text: Removable building hardware is among the materials EPA identifies as candidates for salvage, donation, or reuse on another project.
entries.applicability: This is general reuse guidance. Whether a particular part fits or performs adequately requires measurements, a condition check, and the receiving project's requirements. It does not establish safety or structural suitability from a photo.

entries.title: Return reusable packaging to suppliers
entries.usageBasis: Original concise paraphrase of factual guidance on a United States government page. No source images, branding, or lengthy extracts are ingested.
entries.text: EPA lists returning packaging materials to suppliers as a reuse option.
entries.applicability: Applies only to actual packaging that the relevant supplier agrees to accept. It does not imply every container is returnable, clean, or suitable for food or chemical storage.

entries.title: Check a local ReStore's material donation options
entries.locator: What can you donate to ReStore?
entries.usageBasis: Original concise paraphrase of donation facts with attribution and a canonical link; no copyrighted page copy, photographs, or logos are ingested.
entries.text: A local Habitat ReStore may be another donation route for new or gently used building materials. Acceptance varies by location, so contact the store with the actual item details first.
entries.applicability: A broad material category does not guarantee acceptance. Confirm the specific item's condition, dimensions, quantity, and the local store's current requirements. ResourceDex is not affiliated with Habitat for Humanity.

entries.title: Arrange a donation before transporting materials
entries.locator: How do you donate items to Habitat ReStore?
entries.usageBasis: Original concise paraphrase of donation facts with attribution and a canonical link; no copyrighted page copy, photographs, or logos are ingested.
entries.text: Contact the local ReStore to discuss the items and agree on a donation method. Confirm donation hours before traveling; they can differ from shopping hours.
entries.applicability: Applies to donations the local store agrees to accept. Pickup service, hours, and item eligibility must be checked directly; this reference does not arrange a pickup.
